verdict.rationale: Angular documents modularity, DI, fine-grained reactivity via Signals, lazy loading, SSR, and tree-shaking/AOT that support scaling to large teams/codebases, and some community users confirm good performance and maintainability in production. However, several independent community reports (albeit from older AngularJS/Angular2 eras) describe real performance degradation with large data bindings/tables and frustration with lack of official guidance, and note incomplete third-party ecosystem — concrete caveats to the 'stays fast at scale' claim. missing for 10: recent independent large-scale benchmarks confirming Signals-based performance holds at scale, and resolution of the historical large-binding performance complaints.
